tldr: 華爾街延續漲勢，道瓊收盤改寫新高，晶片股領軍那斯達克走揚，AI 需求續強的訊號支撐科技類股。
台積電在 7 月 16 日法說會前續處歷史高檔，2026 年美元營收上看年增約 37%，AI 與高效能運算為主要動能。
聯準會在新任主席華許主持下維持利率 3.5%–3.75%，油價通膨趨緩與就業轉弱使升降息按兵不動。
國內監理動作不停：金管會就清算款遭挪用裁罰銀行，稅務機關則提醒遺贈稅與房地合一相關規定。
外資 6 月大舉調節台股，減碼面板、記憶體與金融權值股，反映資金板塊輪動。

items.title_zh: 台積電守穩歷史高檔，撐住大盤高檔震盪
items.title_en: TSMC holds record ground, keeping the broad index elevated
items.summary_zh: 台積電（2330）成交價約 2,460 元、上漲約 15 元或 0.6%，續處歷史高價區，帶動加權指數在 46,500 點一帶高檔整理。盤面成交金額維持在逾兆元的量能水準，半導體、IC 設計與被動元件等權值與族群吸走多數買盤。由於 AI 驅動的需求仍是市場主旋律，指數方向與台積電及其供應鏈高度連動，法人聚焦即將登場的 7 月中旬法說旺季，觀察權值股能否延續高檔動能並帶動指數再攻高。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330) traded around NT$2,460, up about NT$15 or 0.6%, keeping the flagship chipmaker near its all-time high and anchoring the benchmark TAIEX in high-consolidation territory around the 46,500 level. Turnover stayed heavy above the NT$1 trillion mark as large-cap semiconductor, IC-design and passive-component names attracted the bulk of trading interest. With AI-driven demand still the market's dominant narrative, index direction remains tightly linked to TSMC and its supply chain heading into the mid-July earnings season.
items.source_name: Yahoo 股市 加權指數

items.title_zh: 外資 6 月大賣台股，寫史上第二大單月賣超
items.title_en: Foreign funds dump Taiwan stocks in June, second-largest monthly sell-off on record
items.summary_zh: 外資 6 月對上市股票淨賣超約 6,018 億元，為史上第二大單月賣超，資金明顯撤出電子與金融權值股。減碼幅度最大者包括群創約 39.3 萬張（估約 261 億元），並大舉調節力積電與華邦電，兩檔記憶體合計賣超約 66.2 萬張。在指數位處歷史高檔之際，這波大規模調節凸顯外資對評價面與板塊輪動風險仍抱持保留態度，後續台股能否維持高檔，需觀察外資是否回補權值股，以及內資與投信的承接力道是否足以支撐盤面人氣。
items.summary_en: Overseas investors net sold about NT$601.8 billion of Taiwan-listed shares in June, the second-heaviest monthly outflow in history, pulling capital out of electronics and financial heavyweights. Among the biggest cuts, foreigners offloaded roughly 393,000 lots of Innolux (about NT$26.1 billion) and heavily trimmed Powerchip and Winbond, with the two memory names shedding a combined 662,000 lots. The scale of selling underscores lingering caution over valuations and rotation risk even as headline indices sit near record highs.
items.source_name: NOWnews：外資 6 月大賣 6018 億

items.title_zh: 台積電 7/16 法說前上修 2026 展望與資本支出
items.title_en: TSMC lifts 2026 outlook and capex ahead of July 16 investor meeting
items.summary_zh: 台積電將於 7 月 16 日在台北召開投資人會議，市場普遍預期管理層將重申樂觀展望。近期指引顯示，2026 年全年美元營收年增率上看約 37%，其中高效能運算（HPC）估成長約 58%，占總營收比重約 67%，成為最主要動能。公司同時將資本支出計畫由 560 億美元上調至 600 億美元，反映 AI 結構性需求正擴散至個人電腦、智慧型手機、汽車與物聯網等終端。此一上修訊號牽動台灣整體半導體供應鏈，從封測、設備到 IC 設計均受惠，也讓法說會前的目標價上修潮持續發酵。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor will convene its next investor conference in Taipei on July 16, with the market widely expecting management to reaffirm an upbeat trajectory. Recent guidance points to full-year 2026 USD revenue growth of about 37%, led by a roughly 58% jump in high-performance computing, which would account for about 67% of sales. The company has also raised its capital expenditure plan to US$60 billion from US$56 billion, reflecting structural AI demand spreading into PCs, smartphones, autos and IoT devices — a signal that reverberates across Taiwan's entire semiconductor supply chain.
items.source_name: 經濟日報：外資啟動台積電目標價上修潮

items.title_zh: 群創加速轉型，切入先進封裝與衛星供應鏈
items.title_en: Innolux accelerates transformation into advanced packaging and satellite supply chain
items.summary_zh: 長期受面板景氣循環與毛利壓力所苦的群創，正積極布局半導體先進封裝與玻璃基板（Glass Substrate）等高附加價值業務，並切入國際衛星供應鏈。此一轉型意在擺脫商品化面板營收的波動，轉向 AI 與通訊驅動的成長領域。儘管群創在 6 月為外資賣超最重的個股之一，其結構性轉型題材仍吸引市場關注，凸顯短線籌碼流動與長線業務重定位之間的拉鋸。對投資人而言，觀察重點在於新業務營收貢獻的實質進度，以及能否改善長期偏低的獲利體質。
items.summary_en: Panel maker Innolux, long pressured by cyclical display margins, is pushing deeper into higher-value businesses including semiconductor advanced packaging and glass substrate, while also entering the international satellite supply chain. The pivot aims to diversify away from commoditised panel revenue toward AI- and communications-driven growth areas. The strategy has drawn investor attention even as the stock featured among foreign investors' heaviest June sell targets, highlighting the tension between near-term trading flows and longer-term structural repositioning.
items.source_name: NOWnews：群創布局玻璃基板與衛星供應鏈

items.title_zh: 金管會就清算款遭挪用裁罰銀行
items.title_en: FSC penalises bank over misappropriated ATM and clearing funds
items.summary_zh: 金管會於 7 月 2 日就中國信託商業銀行前行員挪用該行 ATM 清算款及財金清算款所涉缺失，作出行政處分。此案延續監理機關近期對銀行內部控制、現金作業流程與員工行為監控的高度關注，先前已有多起類似裁罰案例。主管機關要求銀行強化對員工經手清算與結帳款項的權限控管，並建立更即時的異常交易與行為偵測機制，以防杜舞弊再度發生。對金融業而言，法遵與內控成本上升，也再次凸顯人員風險與作業風險管理的重要性。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission on July 2 imposed administrative sanctions related to a former employee at CTBC Bank who misappropriated the bank's ATM settlement and interbank clearing funds. The action reflects the regulator's continued focus on internal controls, cash-handling procedures and staff conduct monitoring across the banking sector, following a string of similar enforcement cases. Banks are being pressed to tighten oversight of employee access to settlement funds and to strengthen anomaly-detection mechanisms to prevent recurrence.
items.source_name: 金管會 新聞稿

items.title_zh: 強制車險保障 7 月起升級
items.title_en: Compulsory auto insurance coverage upgraded from July
items.summary_zh: 保險局先前公告強制汽車責任保險保障升級，自 7 月起身故及失能理賠上限提高至最高 300 萬元。此次調整提高道路事故受害人及其家屬的基本保障水準，屬強制保險制度給付上限的定期檢討與上調。保險業者須據此調整準備金提存與費率精算假設，而保戶則在不改變商品強制性的前提下，取得更完整的法定保障。整體而言，制度面的保障提升有助強化社會安全網，長期也可能牽動車險損率與費率結構的變化，值得產險業持續關注。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Insurance Bureau earlier announced an upgrade to compulsory automobile liability insurance, raising the maximum death and disability benefit to NT$3 million effective from July. The enhancement lifts baseline protection for road-accident victims and their families, and marks a periodic recalibration of the mandatory scheme's benefit ceilings. Insurers will need to adjust reserving and pricing assumptions accordingly, while policyholders gain broader statutory coverage without materially altering the compulsory nature of the product.
items.source_name: 保險局 全球資訊網

items.title_zh: 保險局預告修正保險業國外投資管理辦法
items.title_en: Insurance Bureau to revise overseas investment rules for insurers
items.summary_zh: 保險局於 6 月初預告修正「保險業辦理國外投資管理辦法」等相關規定，以落實保險業風險管理並促進資本強化。此次修法屬於引導業者在全球市場波動與匯率變動下，將海外資產部位與審慎風險控管相互對接的整體政策一環。對持有大量海外債券與股票部位的壽險業者而言，新框架可能影響其資產配置彈性、避險操作與資本適足規劃。業者須及早評估法規調整對投資策略與匯兌成本的影響，並在收益與風險之間取得平衡。
items.summary_en: The Insurance Bureau in early June pre-announced amendments to the regulations governing insurers' overseas investments, aiming to reinforce risk management and promote capital strengthening across the industry. The proposed changes are part of a broader effort to align insurers' foreign-asset exposure with prudent risk controls amid volatile global markets and currency swings. For life insurers with large offshore bond and equity holdings, the revised framework could influence asset allocation flexibility, hedging practices and capital adequacy planning going forward.
items.source_name: 保險局 全球資訊網

items.title_zh: 7 月為台股 ETF 配息旺季
items.title_en: July marks a peak dividend season for Taiwan ETFs
items.summary_zh: 台股 ETF 配息集中於 1、4、7、10 月，使 7 月成為存息族一年中的重要配息窗口。0050、00919、00878 等熱門標的，仍是「以領息為本」存股族打造穩定現金流的核心持股。在 2026 年市場仍震盪的環境下，財富管理端提醒投資人可搭配單檔或多檔 ETF，依個人資金需求調整領息時點，讓定期定額與股息再投入策略成為資產配置主軸。對高資產與一般投資人而言，配息旺季前的成分股、殖利率與最後買進日等資訊，是布局現金流組合的關鍵參考，宜留意除息後的填息表現與整體總報酬。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's exchange-traded fund payouts cluster in January, April, July and October, making July one of the year's key distribution windows for income-focused investors. Popular names such as 0050, 00919 and 00878 remain core holdings for dividend-oriented "share-savers" building steady cash-flow strategies. With markets still choppy in 2026, wealth managers note that investors can mix single or multiple ETFs to tailor income timing to personal cash-flow needs, keeping regular-investment and dividend-reinvestment plans central to portfolio construction.
items.source_name: 豐雲學堂：2026 存股族最愛 ETF 排行

items.title_zh: 2026 年市值型與主動型 ETF 表現看俏，高息型相對承壓
items.title_en: Market-cap and active ETFs seen outshining high-dividend strategies in 2026
items.summary_zh: 市場分析認為，高股息 ETF 在 2026 年恐難有特別突出的表現，因市值型與主動式 ETF 在成長型行情中具先天優勢。對高息型商品而言，重點將回到能穩定配息的成分股，如電信三雄與金融股，而此格局全年可能不易改變。此觀點強化財富管理組合的槓鈴式配置思維：以成長導向的市值型部位搭配精選的收益型標的，而非單押殖利率。對財管客戶而言，理解不同 ETF 類型在多空環境下的角色差異，有助於在追求現金流與資本利得之間取得平衡，避免因追高息而忽略總報酬與填息風險。
items.summary_en: Analysts suggest high-dividend ETFs may lack standout performance in 2026, as market-capitalisation-weighted and actively managed ETFs enjoy structural advantages in a growth-led market. For high-yield products, the focus shifts to constituents that can reliably sustain payouts — such as telecom majors and financial stocks — a dynamic unlikely to change through the year. The view reinforces a barbell approach in wealth portfolios: pairing growth-oriented market-cap exposure with carefully selected income names rather than relying on dividend yield alone.
items.source_name: CMoney：2026 年 ETF 趨勢解析

items.title_zh: 北區國稅局公告重大欠稅案件
items.title_en: North district tax office publishes list of major tax delinquents
items.summary_zh: 財政部北區國稅局於 7 月 1 日公告重大欠稅及重大逃漏稅案件，公告期間自 7 月 1 日起至 12 月 31 日止。此一公告機制雖屬例行，卻是稅務機關對重大欠稅採取執法態度的明確提醒。對納稅人及其顧問而言，這凸顯及時申報與繳納的重要性，因為一旦被公開列名，除財務追繳外亦伴隨商譽與信用受損的後果。高資產族群在進行資產移轉與稅務規劃時，應留意欠稅風險與強制執行程序，避免因疏漏或爭議而遭列管，並可透過事前的稅務健檢與合規安排降低風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's National Taxation Bureau of the Northern Area on July 1 published its roster of major tax-arrears and major tax-evasion cases, with the public-disclosure period running from July 1 through December 31. The publication mechanism is a routine but pointed reminder of the authorities' enforcement posture against significant unpaid tax liabilities. For taxpayers and their advisers, it underscores the importance of timely filing and settlement, as public listing carries reputational as well as financial consequences.
items.source_name: 財政部北區國稅局

items.title_zh: 房地合一 2.0 將特定股權交易納入課稅
items.title_en: House-and-land tax 2.0 captures certain share transfers
items.summary_zh: 依房地合一稅 2.0 制度，個人交易特定股權若符合一定條件，應申報並可能課稅。規定將個人直接或間接持有股份或出資額過半數的國內外非上市、非上櫃及非興櫃公司股權納入課稅範圍，且該被投資公司股權價值有 50% 以上係由中華民國境內的房屋、土地所構成者，其股權交易視同房地交易課稅。此舉旨在防堵透過公司股權間接移轉不動產以規避房地交易稅的漏洞。對持有不動產控股架構的高資產客戶而言，股權移轉、家族傳承與重組前，務必檢視是否觸發此一視同房地交易的申報義務，以免遭補稅及裁罰。
items.summary_en: Under Taiwan's house-and-land unified income tax 2.0 regime, individuals disposing of certain equity interests must file and may be taxed if specific conditions are met. The rules bring within scope transfers of shares or capital contributions in non-listed, non-OTC and non-emerging companies where the individual directly or indirectly holds more than half the equity, and where 50% or more of that entity's value derives from domestic real estate. The provision aims to close loopholes where property is transferred indirectly via corporate shells to avoid property-transaction tax.
items.source_name: 財政部中區國稅局 房地合一專區

items.title_zh: 農地贈與直系血親免徵贈與稅，須符合 5 年農用要件
items.title_en: Farmland gifts to lineal relatives remain gift-tax exempt with a five-year condition
items.summary_zh: 稅務機關重申，作農業使用的農地贈與直系血親卑親屬、父母、兄弟姊妹或祖父母，可申請免徵贈與稅。惟受贈人自受贈日起 5 年內須將該土地持續作農業使用，不得移轉或變更為非農業使用，否則將被追繳原免徵的贈與稅。此提醒對持有農地並規劃跨代傳承的家庭而言，是重要的實務規劃要點。財富傳承顧問在設計農地移轉方案時，應同步評估後續 5 年的農用維持義務與可能的追稅風險，並搭配整體資產配置與繼承規劃，避免因短期內處分或變更用途而喪失稅負優惠。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's tax authorities reiterate that farmland used for agriculture, when gifted to lineal descendants, parents, siblings or grandparents, may qualify for gift-tax exemption. The recipient must, however, continue using the land for agriculture for five years from the date of the gift and may not transfer it or convert it to non-agricultural use during that period; otherwise the exempted tax is reclaimed. The reminder is a practical planning point for families holding agricultural land as part of intergenerational wealth transfer.
items.source_name: 商周：2026 贈與稅全攻略

items.title_zh: 通膨趨緩、就業轉弱，聯準會在華許主持下維持利率
items.title_en: Fed holds rates as inflation moderates and jobs soften under new Chair Warsh
items.summary_zh: 美國聯準會結束為期兩天的會議——這是新任主席華許（Kevin Warsh）上任後主持的首場會議——決議維持利率於 3.5% 至 3.75% 的目標區間不變。分析指出，隨著油價通膨趨緩、就業市場浮現部分疲軟，央行至少在下次會議前可能維持按兵不動。此立場使貨幣政策處於觀望姿態，在通膨壓力降溫與勞動市場動能放緩之間取得平衡。市場正密切解讀後續公布的物價與就業數據，以尋找政策下一步方向的線索，此對美元、美債殖利率與新興市場資金流向均具指標意義。
items.summary_en: At the conclusion of its two-day meeting — the first under new Chairman Kevin Warsh — the U.S. Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged at a target range of 3.5% to 3.75%. Analysts note that with oil-price inflation moderating and some softness emerging on the jobs front, the central bank is likely to stay on hold at least through the next meeting. The stance keeps policy in a wait-and-see posture, balancing cooling price pressures against a labour market that is losing some momentum, with markets parsing incoming data for the next directional cue.
items.source_name: CNBC：Stock market news for July 6, 2026

items.title_zh: 華爾街上半年繳出多年最佳表現，奠定總經基調
items.title_en: Wall Street posts its best first half in years, setting the macro backdrop
items.summary_zh: 美國主要股指以強勁漲幅結束 2026 年上半年：道瓊上漲 8.9%，為 2021 年以來最佳上半年表現；標普 500 上漲 9.6%，那斯達克上漲 12.8%；小型股羅素 2000 更飆升近 22%，創 1991 年以來最佳上半年。此波從大型科技股延伸至小型股的全面上攻，反映市場對成長前景仍具韌性、對通膨的疑慮亦見緩和，為下半年鋪陳相對正向的總經背景。不過投資人仍須權衡評價偏高與政策風險，觀察企業獲利能否兌現高預期，以判斷這波多頭是否具備延續的基本面支撐。
items.summary_en: U.S. equity benchmarks closed the first six months of 2026 with strong gains: the Dow climbed 8.9% — its best first-half showing since 2021 — while the S&P 500 rose 9.6% and the Nasdaq advanced 12.8%. The small-cap Russell 2000 surged nearly 22%, its best first half since 1991. The broad-based advance, spanning large-cap tech to small caps, reflects resilient growth expectations and easing inflation fears, framing a constructive macro backdrop into the second half even as investors weigh valuation and policy risks.
items.source_name: CNBC：Stock market news for July 6, 2026

items.title_zh: AI 需求訊號牽動台灣晶片供應鏈
items.title_en: AI demand signals ripple through Taiwan's chip supply chain
items.summary_zh: 全球晶片市場氣氛轉強，輝達（Nvidia）的組裝夥伴鴻海精密釋出 AI 需求持續增強的訊號，帶動華爾街半導體類股走揚，也強化以出口為重的台灣科技聚落展望。在記憶體廠營運更新前，晶片股普遍上漲，對台灣晶圓代工、封裝與零組件供應鏈具正面外溢效果，使 AI 資本支出續居區域股市敘事核心，並支撐權值股評價。台廠投資人可留意 AI 供應鏈訂單能見度，以及國際大廠資本支出計畫的落地進度。
items.summary_en: Global chip sentiment strengthened as Nvidia's assembly partner Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn) signalled that AI demand continues to intensify, helping lift semiconductor names on Wall Street and reinforcing the outlook for Taiwan's export-heavy tech complex. With chipmakers rallying ahead of updates from memory makers, the read-through for Taiwan's foundry, packaging and component suppliers is broadly positive, keeping AI capital spending at the centre of the regional equity narrative and underpinning heavyweight valuations.
items.source_name: 24/7 Wall St：Nasdaq tech propels markets on chip strength

items.title_zh: 道瓊收盤創新高，華爾街漲勢延續（2026-07-06）
items.title_en: Dow closes at a record as Wall Street's rally rolls on (2026-07-06)
items.summary_zh: 美股週一延續漲勢，標普 500 上漲 0.72% 收 7,537.43 點，那斯達克綜合指數上漲 1.12% 收 26,121.16 點，道瓊上漲 155.84 點（0.29%）收在 53,055.91 點的歷史新高。科技類股全面走高帶動大盤。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks maintained upward momentum Monday, with the S&P 500 gaining 0.72% to 7,537.43, the Nasdaq Composite adding 1.12% to 26,121.16, and the Dow rising 155.84 points (0.29%) to a record close of 53,055.91. Tech led broadly.
items.source_name: CNBC：Stock market news for July 6, 2026

items.title_zh: 記憶體與晶片股推升那斯達克（2026-07-06）
items.title_en: Memory and chip stocks power the Nasdaq higher (2026-07-06)
items.summary_zh: 半導體類股領軍週一漲勢，超微（AMD）大漲 6.6%、英特爾上漲 1.5%、美光上漲 0.9%。在三星銷售更新與 SK 海力士 ADR 發行前，晶片股走強，記憶體與 AI 相關個股續為市場焦點。
items.summary_en: Semiconductor names led Monday's advance, with AMD surging 6.6%, Intel up 1.5% and Micron gaining 0.9%. Chipmakers rallied ahead of Samsung's sales update and SK Hynix's ADR issuance later in the week, keeping memory and AI-linked names in focus.
items.source_name: 24/7 Wall St：Tech propels markets on chip strength

items.title_zh: 威騰電子大漲 7%，受財報與股息調升激勵（2026-07-06）
items.title_en: Western Digital jumps 7% on results and a dividend hike (2026-07-06)
items.summary_zh: 威騰電子（Western Digital）上漲約 7%，為當日領漲個股之一，主因其將季度現金股息調升 20% 至每股 0.15 美元，並公布強勁的 2026 會計年度第三季財報。公司強調 AI 工作負載產生的資料可經濟地儲存於硬碟，支撐需求。
items.summary_en: Western Digital rose about 7%, one of the day's standout movers, after raising its quarterly cash dividend 20% to $0.15 per share and posting strong Q3 FY26 results. The company emphasised that AI workloads generate data stored cost-efficiently on HDDs, supporting demand.
items.source_name: SEC 8-K：Western Digital Q3 FY26 press release

items.title_zh: 博通因延長與蘋果合作走高，輝達小漲（2026-07-06）
items.title_en: Broadcom gains on extended Apple partnership; Nvidia edges up (2026-07-06)
items.summary_zh: 博通（Broadcom）在延長與蘋果的合作後上漲 3.7%，蘋果同步上漲 1.3%。輝達上漲 0.4%，因組裝夥伴鴻海精密釋出 AI 需求持續增強的訊號，強化了推動整體科技股上漲的 AI 硬體題材。
items.summary_en: Broadcom rose 3.7% after extending its partnership with Apple, which added 1.3%. Nvidia gained 0.4% after assembly partner Hon Hai Precision Industry signalled that AI demand continues to strengthen, reinforcing the AI-hardware theme driving the broader tech rally.
items.source_name: 24/7 Wall St：Tech propels markets on chip strength

items.title_zh: 聯準會首場華許主持會議維持利率 3.5%–3.75%（2026-07-06）
items.title_en: Fed holds rates at 3.5%–3.75% in Warsh's first meeting (2026-07-06)
items.summary_zh: 市場解讀聯準會至少在下次會議前可能維持不變，此前央行在新任主席華許主持的首場會議上維持利率不動。油價通膨趨緩與就業數據轉弱，支持央行採取觀望的政策立場。
items.summary_en: Markets read the Fed as likely to stay on hold at least through the next meeting, after the central bank — in its first gathering under new Chair Kevin Warsh — kept rates unchanged. Moderating oil-price inflation and softer jobs data support a patient policy stance.
items.source_name: CNBC：Stock market news for July 6, 2026

items.title_zh: 華爾街繳出多年最佳上半年（2026-07-06）
items.title_en: Wall Street logs its best first half in years (2026-07-06)
items.summary_zh: 回顧 2026 年上半年，道瓊上漲 8.9%（2021 年以來最佳上半年），標普 500 上漲 9.6%，那斯達克上漲 12.8%，小型股羅素 2000 更飆升近 22%，創 1991 年以來最強上半年，凸顯市場全面走強。
items.summary_en: Recapping the first six months of 2026, the Dow climbed 8.9% (its best first half since 2021), the S&P 500 rose 9.6% and the Nasdaq advanced 12.8%, while the small-cap Russell 2000 surged nearly 22% — its strongest first half since 1991 — underscoring broad-based market strength.
items.source_name: CNBC：Stock market news for July 6, 2026
